method: Direct full recursive Git tree comparison: set union of every blob path, compare Git blob SHAs/modes/sizes. Independently cross-reference pinned 436-file executable inventory. Unlike GitHub compare commits' 300-files display cap, this includes all changed, added or removed blob paths at both verified trees. This is NOT semantic review, source line count, proof of zero bugs, or rename provenance.
renames: Git tree paths do not encode rename history; do not infer rename identity without independent diff/context
priority: Review 37 modified pinned eligible and 88 added code/workflow/test paths, particularly release safety, app and Auth boundaries; full per-line and dependency audit needed. Also review remaining non-code changes per original historical and new source risk.
